parameters.help_en: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
Configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: Query global configurations.
rule: Query rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, no distinction is made between global and rule configurations
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置。

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: Rule name. You can query the rule whose name matches the specified value
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: version 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

AltSvc.description_en:
Alt-Svc feature switch. Disabled by default. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
AltSvc.description_zh:
Alt-Svc功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AltSvcClear.description_en:
Whether the Alt-Svc header includes the clear parameter. Disabled by default. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
AltSvcClear.description_zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AltSvcMa.description_en: Alt-Svc validity period in seconds. Default value: 86400 seconds
AltSvcMa.description_zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒

AltSvcPersist.description_en:
Whether the Alt-Svc header includes the persist parameter. Disabled by default. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
AltSvcPersist.description_zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值：
on：开启。
off：关闭

ConfigType.description_en:
Configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:

global: Query global configurations.
rule: Query rule configurations
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

Hsts.description_en:
Whether to enable HSTS. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Hsts.description_zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HstsIncludeSubdomains.description_en:
Whether to include subdomains in HSTS. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
HstsIncludeSubdomains.description_zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HstsPreload.description_en:
Whether to enable HSTS preload. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
HstsPreload.description_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsForce.description_en:
Whether to enable forced HTTPS. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
HttpsForce.description_zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。

off：关闭

HttpsForceCode.description_en:
Forced HTTPS redirect status code. Valid values:
301
302
307
308
HttpsForceCode.description_zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
301
302
307
308

HttpsNoSniDeny.description_en:
Whether to enable denial of TLS handshake requests without SNI. Disabled by default. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
HttpsNoSniDeny.description_zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsSniVerify.description_en:
Whether to enable SNI verification. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
HttpsSniVerify.description_zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HttpsSniWhitelist.description_en: Specifies the list of allowed SNI whitelist entries, separated by spaces
HttpsSniWhitelist.description_zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔

Rule.description_en:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: Rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: Rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: version 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

PageNumber.description_en: Current page number, same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber
